title: req task envelope
description: The only accepted final message of a delegated worker or reviewer (AGENTS.md, Orchestration). Process tooling: unrelated to the Baseline manifest's baseline_envelope. Checked by tools/orchestration/validate_envelope.py.

files_changed.description: For a worker: the files it changed, at least one. For a review envelope (task_id contains '-review-'): the files it flagged; may be empty.

tests.description: The gate verdict, e.g. 'scripts/check.sh exit 0 (full run)'. A --fast run is an iteration verdict, never this field's answer; state every SKIP and UNVERIFIABLE.

blockers.description: Exactly one question when status is blocked: a single line ending in '?'. Otherwise null.

summary.description: At most 10 non-empty lines. No transcript.

red.description: Red-at-base proof for the test this unit fixes. Required when task_id ends in -fix (or a numbered -fix2).

base_commit.description: The commit the test was proven red at.

failure.description: The assertion the test produced at base, not a compile error and not "no tests found".

mutations.description: Named mutations and the test each one must turn red. Evidence that the tests have teeth.

pr.description: The pull request URL, when the unit opened one.
